snippet.title: [VR Game] Bladeline VR: Intense Sword Action & Epic Combos! Promotion Video
snippet.description:
Experience the thrill of sword fighting in Bladeline VR! This immersive VR game offers powerful sword actions, exciting music, and stunning visuals. Battle against evil humanoids, master accurate sword swings, and maintain deadly kill combos. But be cautious of the assassins - one strike can be fatal!

Unlock and customize skills at the skill shop to become even more powerful, and choose from a variety of cool-looking swords. Compete with players around the world for the highest score on the Steam Leaderboard. With continuous updates and new features, Bladeline VR promises endless fun and challenges for virtual reality gamers!

🎮 Key Features:
- Innovative VR melee weapon actions
- Skill customization based on your strategy
- Exciting sounds and brilliant effects
- Assassins and projectiles providing varied situations
- Global competition via Steam Leaderboard

⚙️ Steam:
- Bladeline VR: Eliminate approaching androids in this action-packed game 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/778110/Bladeline_VR/
